verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS compliance and security platform that holds customer data and ships AI features (Fieldwork AI agents, an MCP server), so asking for an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions training-data usage, opt-out controls, or any no-training commitment. The OAuth/RBAC scoping docs cover access control for assistants, not whether data is used for model training.
